S.FORM: alang Cu ki ngo ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Ku'ang sang go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 337 buwan, 843 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 16% kyan ku 134 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 84% kyan ku 709 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 13%, Bunun 2%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Cu ki ngo hya' ga wsilung krahu'. tay 'zil na Cu ki ngo hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Cu ki ngo hya' ga Kano go. tay mkraya' na Cu ki ngo hya' ga Chishang. tay mkraya' na Cu ki ngo hya' ga Cipurungan. tay 'llaw na Cu ki ngo hya' ga Himoti. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Cu ki ngo ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu kuʔaŋ [s|ɕ]aŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** βunun * rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ħjaʔ ɣa w[s|ɕ]iluŋ kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ħjaʔ ɣa kano ɣo taj mkrajaʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]ħi[s|ɕ]ħaŋ taj mkrajaʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]ipuruŋan taj ʔllaw na [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ħjaʔ ɣa ħimoti reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]u ki ŋo ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
